name: dossier-sonnet
description: Experimental (2026-11-19; trial B of docs/26): K6 with Claude Sonnet 5.5 high as the solver. Claude Haiku 5.5 scouts a big repository into a facts-only dossier when the gate says there is a search to save (F130), then Sonnet fixes the request in its own session from the dossier. Measures whether Sonnet with a dossier keeps Opus's wins.
